9d6f5228-d182-571a-83d2-6a67becb7736.content: Specify the order and recipients for reporting serious discomfort during the study.

00ed485d-66c2-59ad-9c5b-9ae445412690.content: Field staff rely on a pre-defined contact sequence when serious discomfort is reported.

9c6e1561-f671-52cb-aa67-245cc4987ad4.content: Establish criteria for halting the use of a design alternative if recurring severe errors appear during formative evaluation.

2381ecf7-2b11-583d-91d9-0a5cfc279ba1.content: Do not include a design alternative halted for safety reasons in subsequent evaluation iterations without modification.

c5ce1b00-36d9-5cdd-a318-93b88ca0e322.content: Even in controlled environments, delayed prototype recovery procedures increase session interruption time and alter data collection conditions for the same task.
